component_policy: Web r36 retains the accepted r35 runtime and adds the bounded online reservation release index across bootstrap, schema healer, capacity installer and license table initialization. Index-only migrations preserve license leases, financial data, quotas, RADIUS routines and triggers. The installer SQL includes the index for new databases. Non-Web images, existing tenant versions and update offers are unchanged.
deployment_limits: Manual installer only; does not distribute an update to existing customers.
Hosted tenant updates require target wrapper, mounts, binding, controller protocol and lease preflight.
Optional hosted RADIUS probe companion is separate, not installed by this runtime bundle.
WhatsApp and unproven idle RAM experiments are excluded.
